mahanadico.name: Mahanadi Coalfields

fin.latest: Apr-Sep 2026: total income ₹17,107.83 cr, profit ₹4,880.66 cr

dividend.policy: Government companies must pay at least 30% of profit or 4% of net worth as dividend, whichever is higher

more.issue: 100% offer for sale by Coal India: up to 66,18,36,300 shares of face value ₹2 (10% of the company). The company gets no money from the issue
quota_lines: Shareholder quota: up to 6,61,83,630 shares, for individuals and HUFs who were public shareholders of Coal India on 13 Nov 2026 (the RHP date). Bid up to ₹2 lakh. No discount is stated for shareholders
Employee quota: up to 3,30,91,815 shares; a discount may be offered, not yet stated
Net offer (after the two quotas): 56,25,60,855 shares: QIB up to 50%, NII at least 15%, Retail at least 35%
more.timeline: Anchor 18 Nov · Opens 19 Nov · Closes 23 Nov · Allotment about 25 Nov · Refund and credit about 26 Nov · Listing about 27 Nov 2026 (NSE and BSE)
risks: Almost all sales (97%) are one product, non-coking coal, and about 70% of it goes to thermal power plants
Revenue from operations fell 1.73% a year and profit 4.95% a year between FY24 and FY26
Contingent liabilities not provided for equal 55.86% of net worth (30 Sep 2026)
Top 10 customers give about 52% of revenue; government power companies about 42%
Fully controlled by Coal India and the Government; top 10 contractors do most of the outsourced work
more.lm: SBI Capital Markets, Axis Capital, BOB Capital Markets, IDBI Capital Markets, IIFL Capital Services
more.rhp: Red Herring Prospectus dated 13 Nov 2026 (647 pages)
more.open_items: Price band, lot size (bid lot) and employee discount are printed as [●] in the RHP. The company will publish them in the price band advertisement (Financial Express, Jansatta) before the issue opens; P/E can be worked out only then
